descript.abstract: Polygon feature class depicting district boundaries for all of Nepal. Districts are the third smallest administrative unit we have mapped. Feature class was created by dissolving ward data.
descript.purpose: For cartography and analysis for the IDE-Gates project.
descript.supplinf: This data came from Dr. Jha. It is reprojected from the original data from Department of Survey, Nepal (projected into WGS84 lat/long). Data were derived from 1:25000-scale topographic maps.

procstep.procdesc:
This data originally came from Dr. Jha. It was derived from 1:25000-scale topographic maps created by the Nepal Survey Department. Topo maps were generally created from imagery flown during the early- to mid-1990s. Data were reprojected from the original data from Department of Survey, Nepal to WGS84.
**********
Ward data was received by GEO/Graphics in shapefile format. The shapefile was imported to a file geodatabase in ArcGIS 9.2. Wards were dissolved to the district level using the "dissolve" geoprocessing tool. Extra attributes were added to give the feature class more functionality.

altsys.altenc: Explicit elevation coordinate included with horizontal coordinates

attrdomv.udom: Sequential unique whole numbers that are automatically generated.
